notes.title: Update has just been released! Mahjong on OS X now!
notes.content:
Hi friends!

We've just released an update for this game.

Now the game is available on OS X also.

Also for PC build the bug with displaying some currencies` symbols in a Bank window was fixed.

Please continue enjoy this game.

notes.title: Update released for the Lost Lands: Mahjong
notes.content:
Dear players of the Lost Lands: Mahjong, greet the new UPDATE. 

Welcome a new Sacrificial Island location, quests and collections!

French, Brazilian-Portuguese, Spanish and Italian versions are finally available.

+ some minor bugs fixed

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Update is available
notes.content:
Hi folks,

With this update the following were done:
- fixed [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/435030/discussions/0/385428458170358751] Bugged/broken Quest: Magnetic Quest [/url]
- Decreased amount of necessary crystals (from 400 to 100) to spend at the beginnnig for Oligarch achievement
- fixed bug when users may see window with sale offer with empty content
- some minor fixes

Thank you for your interest to this game. 
We are happy to know that you like to play it.
